title: Super Supportive

source.nextStart: Fifteen minutes later, Alden and his friends arrived at the Artonan consulate building.
source.continuationNote: Arrival and food delivery to Gorgon. End after Alden admits his specific dream, before the deeper background about Hannah’s suspicion.

completed.end: Hannah agrees to ask about the shrapnel and admires Alden’s scar; he feels heard. The cause of his parents’ deaths is not yet explained.
Hannah explains the bubble and the pursuit to the empty building. Alden learns that even his rescuer does not fully understand her powers.
Hannah admits counting the wrong floor. Alden cries and shouts for everyone to leave; Hannah goes while Amanda approaches, the opposite of what he wanted.
Alden finishes his System homework but cannot sleep in the noisy apartment.
Alden tests the response time; Connie reaches and comforts him in eight seconds. The ninety-second question remains unresolved.
Alden finds Hannah’s note, calls, and learns she listed him as a priority contact. He chooses audio only; the System forwards his call before Hannah answers.
At Cly’s farewell brunch Hannah receives Alden’s call, confirms approximately ninety seconds, and is rattled by his abrupt goodbye. The call notification flashes again and she answers immediately.
Alden offers his explanation for his parents’ deaths and asks Hannah to tell Thomas. Hannah promises a summer visit and teleport, then learns how costly it will be. School break is in three weeks.
Five years later, Alden and friends trade jokes on their way to alien school; he privately asks to replay his last three voicemails.

Alden replays Hannah’s summons message and Cly’s two updates. Hannah has been missing six months; her friends propose a funeral on her birthday. Alden switches off the System without answering the teleport invitation. Her death is not confirmed.

After replaying the messages, Alden sees the repaired city and recalls Hannah’s changed heroic motto. At eleven he found it sad; now he considers Skiff’s emotional burden and why complementary support could change a fight. Hannah’s absence remains unresolved.

Jeremy brings Alden back to the train stop. Friends tease one another about being funny, mean and nice. Jeremy identifies Alden’s persistent heroic dream beneath his sensible college planning; Alden is embarrassed and Boe is impressed.
